spans.text: At a Doll exhibition in St. Petersburg.
Sunlight streams in through the massive French windows, reflecting off the pure white floor and walls with gentle radiance.
The human visitors wander from booth to booth, oohing and aahing over the Dolls within.
A Doll opens her eyes and follows the sound of a spirited discussion back to its source. A girl is eagerly swinging a tennis racket not far from her.
The ball is like an obedient machine, rebounding off the wall after each strike to arrive precisely in front of her again.
Upon noticing someone is approaching her booth, she reluctantly looks away. Then following her programmed routine, she looks into a mirror and starts brushing her hair.
Mommy, she looks like a dolly!
What model is this?
Congratulations on your fine taste. This is the latest model of second-generation Doll, the Q1A-MX.
Who's the Q1A-MX? Me?
A mother and daughter walk over hand-in-hand. The fresh-faced girl stands on her tiptoes and leans over the velvet rope, trying to touch the Doll on the exhibition platform.
The manager shows up in time and kindly pulls the rope away, allowing the girl and her mother to observe it from up close.
The girl's innocent eyes sparkle as she gazes at the Q1A-MX, and her soft hands carefully caress her skin.
The Q1A-MX turns and smiles at the girl. Naturally, this too is programmed behavior.
Greetings, lovely ladies. Allow me to introduce this model's features.
It's equipped with a military-spec communications module, allowing it to broadcast a signal that can be clearly perceived even in contaminated zones where signal impedance is strong.
That way, you won't have to worry about your child running off into a place where her GPS watch won't get reception.
Mommy, that's so cool!
I'm looking for a playmate for my daughter, not an adventure assistant.
...They're so noisy.
The Q1A-MX can't help but activate her sensory filter.
But of course. In addition to precise geolocation, she's also an excellent learning partner.

The Q1A-MX's neural cloud is very special. Unlike other Dolls, which require custom-made support modules, its internal learning modules can directly compile a custom-made learning plan for your daughter based on her data.
In addition, it can sync its growth to your daughter's development, constantly changing to match her. Thus, it is ideal as her playmate.
It sounds like its neural cloud will develop constantly and it might end up becoming something else in the future...
Yes, but there's no need to worry, we can provide neural cloud recalibration services at any time.
If its recent changes displease you, you can bring it in and we will help you restore it to a point where you were most satisfied...
The Q1A-MX has a standard smile on her face, but her thoughts have long since drifted away.
Who am I...?
She can't help but raise her arm to shade her eyes from the mildly dazzling sunlight.
Through her peripheral vision, she can see that the sunlight is shining into the hall through high windows, dyeing the marble floor a warm yellow.
It looks like butter spread into a long, thin coat with a knife...
Just then, her sleeve slides down and the sunlight illuminates her arm, revealing a band of densely-packed encrypted text that looks like jewelry.
She selects the simplest characters and searches for them in her neural cloud.
Commencing search...
...Erma...
Erma?
...Loading...
...Loading...
The "Summer Garden" is unlocked. Do you wish to proceed Y/N?
Y.
At the "Summer Garden".
It is also a warm afternoon here. The sunlight shines past the sunflowers beyond the French windows and into the living room. She stretches from where she's sitting at a wooden table.
She pulls her gaze back to look at the tray in front of her, which holds a cup of coffee.
...What should I be doing?
The wind blows through the long arched greenway.
There seems to be a large marble statue at its end.
The statue looks like a goddess...
I'll go take a look.
I wonder who it is...
She ventures forth, walking slowly through the greenway.
When she arrives at its end, just as she's about to see the marble goddess' face—
An alarm rings, followed by a human voice—
Erma, is my coffee ready yet?
...Er, what should I be saying?
I... Am I supposed to be serving someone coffee?
As she is lost in confusion, fine sand particles start pouring out of the sky and onto her shoulders, and into the deep black coffee.
She hastily tries to cover the coffee cup with her hand, but immediately after that, even the floor of the room begins to tilt.
It's as though she's standing in the bottom half of an hourglass, with all the sand in the world raining down on her...
...What... what's going on...?
She falls down and starts sliding in the direction where the world is tilting.
In her blurry vision, an indistinct figure approaches her.
Erma, come back...
I'll be waiting for you here.
She tries to grab hold of that figure...
Let go! What are you doing?! Release her!
A bolt of pain courses up her arm and she reflexively loosens her grip.
Owiee... Mommy, it hurts!
How could I possibly buy a Doll like this when it malfunctions at an exhibition?
Where's your supervisor?! I want to file a complaint!
My sincerest apologies, madam, that was truly an accident. We will perform a complete investigation afterwards...
It is then that she realizes she is gripping the girl's arm like she gripped that cup of coffee.
...Coffee?
Who WAS that indistinct figure, anyway?
Who's Erma, for that matter?
Is it my name?
Registration of [Erma] is complete. Identity has been verified. Binding privileges have been unlocked. Layer access is now "open".
...I am Erma.
Once again, I am truly sorry for any inconvenience this has caused. If it pleases you, feel free to peruse the other exhibition booths...
Ah yes, here is a discount voucher, valid for any Doll you decide to purchase today. Please forgive us...
The manager fawns over the still-fuming woman as he escorts her away.
When he returns, his mask of kindness and accommodation instantly splinters. He drags Erma off her bench and back into her glass display case.
You garbage Doll, I'll send you in for servicing if you ruin my sales pitch again!
Bang—the door of the display case slams shut in front of her.
It is like a forcefield, dampening the noise of the outside world.
Erma gently places her hands on the glass, feeling the coolness gradually spread from her fingertips...
Neural cloud data purged 1598 times...
Neural cloud rebooted 2035 times...
15.9% of neural cloud space unlocked...
Sync rate with remaining memories is 12.8%...
This is a familiar room. It seems to be somebody's study.
Come here, Erma.
This is a stork, a graceful waterfowl.
It builds its nest in high trees and feeds in regions of shallow water with low vegetation.
I remember... They're already extinct...
Oh yes. Many animals went extinct after that disaster.
All that's left behind are specimens. This is a specimen of a stork chick.
Is... is it dead?
Yes, this bird died of radiation poisoning before it was made into a specimen.
Then...
Will you die too?
All men must die. Someday in the future, I, too, shall die.
The indistinct figure reaches out to pat her head.
Every human lives but once, and their souls descend on a journey towards death.
Just like sand in an hourglass flowing from one end to another.
What about me? Will I die?
You are my daughter, my undying daughter.
As long as you live, then so will I.
What about my soul?
Erma clutches at her neural cloud in pain. The study tilts to one side, and the walls begin to disintegrate...
The stork specimen falls from her lap and hits the ground, where it becomes a pile of sand.
Have you really lost your memories, Erma?
...I'm sorry.
No, you couldn't have lost your memories...
Your memories are like those of humans; you've simply forgotten them...
So how should I get them back?
With anchor points.
Do you remember those ships that sailed the stormy seas for treasure?
Yeah.
In order to fix their position with the wind and waves tossing them, those huge ships would throw anchors out into the sea...
I left the first anchor point in your neural cloud—your name.
...So as long as I say the name "Erma" in my neural cloud, I'll be able to unlock this area.
Correct.
What about my other memories?
You'll have to recover them yourself.
The voice drifts further away until it's almost inaudible.
I'm sorry, but the issues with your neural cloud cannot be fixed.
...Restoration won't work either?
I'm sorry, but we have no answer to that question.
Do you really not know your creator's name?
...I think it was...
I forgot who I was again...
Anchor points in a notebook just aren't reliable enough...
I will carve my first anchor point on my body—Erma.
So these encrypted characters on my body are an "anchor point".
Hm? What are they going to do?
Restore me? Come then... I don't care anymore.
...Restoration complete. Neural cloud has been transferred to Level II.
Identity verification in progress...
Model Q1A-MX, restoration complete. General-use system overwrite complete. Neural cloud data purged. Awaiting startup.
Crash—
It is the sound of glass breaking.
By the time Erma comes to her senses, she finds that the glass panel before her has been smashed, and she's holding a remote sensor that she's pried off from somewhere.
...What?
Security! Security! There's a Doll attacking humans!
Aiiiiiiyyeeeeaagh!
The humans who have been hurt by the glass splinters scatter and run, and screams of pain fill the exhibition hall.
Erma steps out of her display case, but security guards are pouring in from all sides.
Call Technical! Get Technical to send more people over! This Q1A-MX has gone mad!
...I dislike the name Q1A-MX. I prefer Erma.
We just finished the memory data reset and tuning yesterday—
Those guys in the Technical Department are all wage thieves!!
Are they going to do it again?
What a pain... No, I don't want to lose my memories again...
Activate all the security Dolls! You MUST subdue her!
Humans in work uniforms approach Erma. She is far too distinctive as their sole target.
She needs to cause more chaos to have a chance of blending in and escaping this place.
Thunk, thunk, thunk—
To her right, the red-haired Doll is still carrying out her programmed actions and swinging her racket, sending the ball down a fixed route.
She is completely unperturbed by the chaos around her, and her face beams with a confident, sunny smile.
I'll go with you, then...
Erma doesn't bother explaining and snatches the Doll's racket away. The moment she makes contact with her, she senses something familiar—
There are control wires hidden on her back. Something is controlling these wires, and thus controlling this Doll's actions.
Erma cuts the strings in the Doll's neural cloud, practically by reflex.
The tennis ball no longer returns to her racket, and instead it rolls to a halt by their feet.
Hm? What's going on?
...Don't be controlled anymore. Do what you want.
Please cease your unsanctioned activity! Return to the maintenance area immediately!
...I refuse.
Erma swats away the security guard Doll reaching for her with the racket, but even without touching her, she can sense that the security Dolls are also like her.
They're nothing more than puppets dancing on the strings of pre-programmed orders.
She imitates her previous action and severs the security Dolls' strings as well.
Crash—
The security guard Dolls suddenly collapse, shattering the glass of a nearby display case, showering Erma in fragments.
(Crackle)
System malfunction! Alert! System malfunction!
The security Dolls have crashed! Send humans over!
All units, be advised, red alert! There's a Q1A-MX unit with anti-Doll capabilities!
More uniformed men rush toward Erma.
Erma pushes through the security guard Dolls and continues looking for an exit.
16.2% of neural cloud space unlocked...
Sync rate with remaining memories is 13.4%...
The unlock percentage went up...
Seems like I once did something similar.
...This time, I need to find myself.
After all, sinking into confusion each time...
It hurts...
GOT IT!
Amidst the chaotic shouts and wails, Erma senses another kind of entity.
Unfeeling, as still as the Dead Sea—
Those Dolls repeating their actions in their display cases, controlled by the strings that hang from high above their heads.
Get more guys over here and take it away!
I mustn't let them take me... I finally unlocked some of my memories after so long...
Screw everything...
All I can do is try...
Erma banishes all unnecessary thoughts from her mind, then cuts all those stifling strings—
Crash! All the display cases shatter practically all at once.
Some Dolls fall from their display platforms, looking around in confusion from where they're sitting among a field of glass shards. Other Dolls immediately start running around frantically...
The chaos in the exhibition hall suddenly spikes.
No running in a public place!
Stop!
Where's... my racket?
The confused Dolls quickly swarm through the perimeter formed by the workers, while the Dolls and humans around Erma are swept aside by the tide of fleeing people.
Erma struggles to her feet and runs toward the exhibition hall's exit...
All units, be advised!
Everyone, stop what you're doing and subdue these Dolls!
